name: Nombres por edad media (Instituto Nacional de Estadística), census 01/01/2025
note: Every given name in the Spanish population census with twenty or more bearers, by sex,
with the count: 31,119 male and 32,321 female names. ANTONIO is borne by 590,938 men
CC BY 4.0, stated by INE for the statistical information on its site and quoted in
LICENSES/ine-nombres.txt. Attribution-only, explicitly including commercial use, so
The `.xlsx` is pinned rather than the `.xls` at the neighbouring path. They are not two
formats of one file: the `.xls` is a stale 2022 edition that INE left in place, and
taking it would silently ship four-year-old data under a 2025 label.
Serves `es`, and through the chain `es_MX` as well. That is a real limitation rather
than an oversight -- Mexican given-name frequencies differ from Spanish ones, and
Mexico's registry would be a separate entry here if an open one turns up.
